sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Fairway Solitaire is a simple yet engaging game that requires strategic thinking and planning to overcome the obstacles in your path. The game is played on a grid, where cards of different suits and values are dealt in a random manner. The objective is to clear the grid by removing all the cards, but the catch is that you can only remove cards that are in descending order (King to Ace) and of the same suit.

            The game starts with a new level, where a set of cards is dealt on the grid. You can then start removing cards by clicking on them, but be cautious, as you can only remove cards that are in descending order and of the same suit. As you progress through the levels, the game becomes increasingly challenging, with more cards being dealt on the grid and the need to think strategically to overcome obstacles.

            One of the unique features of Fairway Solitaire is the 'Power-Ups' system, where you can earn special cards that offer various bonuses, such as removing multiple cards at once or skipping a few levels. These Power-Ups can be a game-changer, but they require careful planning and strategy to use effectively.

sections.heading: Beginner Tips and Tricks
sections.body:
If you're new to Fairway Solitaire, here are a few beginner tips and tricks to help you get started:

            Start with the easiest levels: Begin with the lowest difficulty level and gradually increase the difficulty as you become more comfortable with the gameplay.

            Focus on removing pairs: The best way to clear the grid is to focus on removing pairs of cards in descending order and of the same suit.

            Use Power-Ups strategically: Power-Ups can be a game-changer, but use them strategically to maximize their effect.

            Practice regularly: The more you play, the better you'll become. Regular practice will help you improve your skills and overcome obstacles.

sections.heading: Advanced Strategies
sections.body:
Once you've mastered the basics of Fairway Solitaire, it's time to move on to more advanced strategies. Here are a few tips to help you improve your skills:

            Use the 'Freeze' feature: The 'Freeze' feature allows you to freeze a card in place, preventing it from moving. Use this feature to block a card that's in the way or to create a path for a card to move.

            Create 'Stacks': Stacks are groups of cards in descending order and of the same suit. Creating stacks is an efficient way to clear the grid, as you can remove multiple cards at once.

            Use the 'Swap' feature: The 'Swap' feature allows you to swap two cards in the grid. Use this feature to move a card to a different location or to create a path for a card to move.

            Plan ahead: Fairway Solitaire is a game that requires planning and strategy. Think ahead and plan your moves carefully to overcome obstacles.
